shellCommands.command: ls /workspace/node_modules/next/dist/docs/ && ls /workspace/app /workspace/lib && cat /workspace/app/page.tsx /workspace/lib/api* 2>/dev/null; cat /workspace/package.json; grep -rl "use cache" /workspace/node_modules/next/dist/docs/ | head -20

cd /workspace && grep -n -A12 "^## Usage\|^### \|cacheLife('hours')\|import { cacheLife\|import { cacheTag\|unstable_\|next/cache" node_modules/next/dist/docs/01-app/03-api-reference/04-functions/cacheLife.md node_modules/next/dist/docs/01-app/03-api-reference/04-functions/cacheTag.md | head -150; ls next.config.* tsconfig.json 2>&1; cat next.config.* 2>/dev/null

grep -n "cacheTag(\|import { cacheTag\|cacheComponents" node_modules/next/dist/docs/01-app/03-api-reference/04-functions/cacheTag.md | head; grep -n "cacheComponents\|not enabled\|without" node_modules/next/dist/docs/01-app/03-api-reference/01-directives/use-cache.md | head

grep -n '"@/\*"\|paths' tsconfig.json; cat > next.config.ts <<'EOF'
import type { NextConfig } from 'next'

const nextConfig: NextConfig = {
  cacheComponents: true,
}

export default nextConfig
EOF
npx tsc --noEmit -p . 2>&1 | head -20; timeout 300 npx next build 2>&1 | tail -25
